before_id.title: Before Id
before_id.description: Draw below this panel. Omit to draw on top of all panels.

arrangement.title: Arrangement
arrangement.description: Omit to tidy the current rows: panels keep their reading-order rows and fill the printable width.

render.title: Render
render.description: Render arranged plots at their assigned sizes, so text prints at true size.

type.title: Type
type.description: A row shares one height across its children; a column shares one width.

aspect.title: Aspect
aspect.description: Preferred width / height for a slot, or for a plot rendered at its panel size. Scaled content always keeps its natural proportions.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: The workspace conversation this turn belongs to. The assistant's conversation context is limited to earlier turns of the same conversation.

DemoDataScope.title: DemoDataScope
DemoDataScope.description: Explicitly select illustrative data instead of project data.

panels.title: Panels
panels.description: Drawing order: later panels are drawn on top.

datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.description: Plots created in this figure use these datasets; none means project data.

min_font_pt.title: Min Font Pt
min_font_pt.description: Text smaller than this on the printed page is reported by the checks.

panels.title: Panels
panels.description: Resolved geometry keyed by panel ID.

figures.title: Figures
figures.description: Plot versions used by panels or offered as updates, keyed by version ID.

datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.description: The figure's datasets, in content order.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: Newer plot versions available, keyed by panel ID.

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: Layout and print problems; none of them block saving.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: Recent renders of plots at their panel sizes.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: The figure assistant conversation, oldest first.

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: Legend text keyed by panel ID.

panels.title: Panels
panels.description: Slots this message fills, in the order they are made.

fill.title: Fill
fill.description: Slots to fill from their descriptions without planning, in this order.

refine.description: A plot panel to refine without planning.

height_mm.title: Height Mm
height_mm.description: The fixed page height, or the maximum height when height_mode is auto.

height_mode.title: Height Mode
height_mode.description: Auto ends the page one margin below the lowest panel.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Displayed size relative to the content's natural size; 1 keeps it unscaled.

label.title: Label
label.description: A custom label. Null assigns the next letter in reading order.

locked.title: Locked
locked.description: Automatic arrangement keeps this panel fixed.

FigurePanelProgress.title: FigurePanelProgress
FigurePanelProgress.description: A slot queued for filling by this message.

FigurePlotStatus.title: FigurePlotStatus
FigurePlotStatus.description: The plot step in progress; questions and approvals come from the shared plot agent.

FigureRefinement.title: FigureRefinement
FigureRefinement.description: A plot panel to refine directly, like refining a figure in a report.

normalized_request.title: Normalized Request
normalized_request.description: Self-contained request preserving the user's goal and relevant prior context.

dataset_ids.title: Dataset Ids
dataset_ids.description: Relevant dataset IDs from the current data catalog. Preserve explicit selection.

reference_image_ids.title: Reference Image Ids
reference_image_ids.description: Select available references; null uses request/refinement defaults. Empty only when clearing reference guidance.

missing_context.title: Missing Context
missing_context.description: Blocking unknowns that cannot be resolved from the supplied context.

questions.title: Questions
questions.description: Essential unresolved decisions for ask_user after checking available context.

data.title: Data
data.description: User-selected data mode. Demo requires an explicit request; otherwise null.

before_id.title: Before Id
before_id.description: Draw below this panel. Omit to draw on top of all panels.

left_key.title: Left Key
left_key.description: A table column containing the left join keys; mutually exclusive with left_axis.

right_key.title: Right Key
right_key.description: A table column containing the right join keys; mutually exclusive with right_axis.

left_axis.title: Left Axis
left_axis.description: Matrix axis identifiers only. Leave null when using a table column key.

right_axis.title: Right Axis
right_axis.description: Matrix axis identifiers only. Leave null when using a table column key.

source_version_id.title: Source Version Id
source_version_id.description: The version this panel's rendering was sized from. Update checks compare against it.

ignored_version_id.title: Ignored Version Id
ignored_version_id.description: A newer version of this plot that the user chose not to apply.

data_summary.title: Data Summary
data_summary.default: Data provenance was not recorded for this version.

sections.title: Sections
sections.description: Document order: a level-1 section is followed by its ordered level-2 subsections.

caption.title: Caption
caption.description: Caption for a standalone image only. Plot captions come from the shared version.

figure_size.description: Explicit output width and height in inches, chosen for this figure's layout and the user's output requirements. Required when render_code is present; null for analysis without a figure. No default canvas size is assumed.

label.title: Label
label.description: The displayed label; null when the label is hidden.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: What the plot should show; the request given to the plotting agent.

SlotPanelContent.title: SlotPanelContent
SlotPanelContent.description: A planned panel: the size and description of a plot that does not exist yet.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When the conversation last received a message.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When the conversation last received a message.

figure.description: The current version of the latest figure this conversation created, including later parameter changes and restores.

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: Questions the assistant asked during this turn, with the answers given.

run.description: The plot or analysis run the turn started.
